summary: Completed comprehensive frontend-only audit of Rahaza Travel ERP. Tested all 20 modules (100% coverage), 3 user roles, and probed 5 known backend bugs for UI exploitability. Identified critical session management issue and confirmed 4 of 5 backend bugs are exploitable through the UI due to missing client-side validation.

backend_issues.note: Backend testing was NOT performed per request (frontend-only audit). Backend bugs were already confirmed by main agent via API testing. This report focuses on UI exploitability of known backend bugs.

critical_bugs.issue: Session expires within 2-3 minutes of inactivity, forcing frequent re-login
critical_bugs.impact: CRITICAL - Severely affects usability, users constantly logged out during normal operations
critical_bugs.observed: Multiple test runs showed session expiry after brief periods, redirecting to login page
critical_bugs.recommendation: Increase session timeout to at least 30-60 minutes or implement sliding session renewal

validation_gaps.issue: No client-side validation prevents negative invoice amounts
validation_gaps.details: Input field type='number' without min='0' attribute allows negative values. Backend bug (negative amounts accepted) IS exploitable via UI.
validation_gaps.recommendation: Add min='0' attribute and client-side validation: if (Number(amount) <= 0) { toast.error('Amount must be positive'); return; }

validation_gaps.issue: No client-side validation prevents negative maintenance costs
validation_gaps.details: Input field type='number' without min='0' attribute allows negative values. Backend bug (negative costs accepted) IS exploitable via UI.
validation_gaps.recommendation: Add min='0' attribute and client-side validation in submit function

validation_gaps.issue: Edit form allows changing datetime/vehicle without conflict validation
validation_gaps.details: PATCH endpoint allows editing start_datetime, end_datetime, and vehicle_id. No client-side conflict checking. Backend double-booking bug IS exploitable via UI edit dialog.
validation_gaps.recommendation: Add client-side conflict check before submission or disable datetime/vehicle editing in edit mode

validation_gaps.issue: Preview button accessible but may trigger backend 500 error with invalid filters
validation_gaps.details: Preview function calls /crm/segments/{id}/preview. If backend returns 500 with invalid segment criteria, only shows generic toast error. Backend bug IS reachable via UI.
validation_gaps.recommendation: Add client-side validation for segment criteria before allowing preview, or improve error messaging

subcharter_double_book_via_edit.details: Edit dialog allows changing start_datetime, end_datetime, and vehicle_id. No client-side conflict validation. Backend PATCH endpoint accepts overlapping bookings.

negative_invoice_amount.details: Invoice form input type='number' without min='0'. No validation in submit function. Backend accepts negative amounts.

negative_maintenance_cost.details: Maintenance form input type='number' without min='0'. No validation in submit function. Backend accepts negative costs.

crm_segment_preview_500.details: Preview button calls /crm/segments/{id}/preview. Invalid segment criteria can trigger backend 500 error. Only shows generic toast error.

cms_content_validation_500.details: ContentFormDialog has `|| 0` fallback for number fields (line 99). Non-numeric input becomes 0, unlikely to trigger backend 500. HTML5 type='number' also provides basic validation.
